title: Analiza nalaza i prioritizacija (CVSS, EPSS, KEV)
title_en: Analyzing findings and prioritization (CVSS, EPSS, KEV)
summary: Tumačenje izlaza alata (Nmap, Masscan, Nessus, Nuclei, OpenVAS, Nikto, ZAP, Burp, Prowler, ScoutSuite, Trivy, Checkov, BAS) i prioritizacija ranjivosti: true/false positive i negative, CVSS 3.1 i 4.0 vektori, EPSS, CISA KEV, SSVC, kontekst imovine, strategije ublažavanja i validacija ispravke.
summary_en: Interpreting tool output (Nmap, Masscan, Nessus, Nuclei, OpenVAS, Nikto, ZAP, Burp, Prowler, ScoutSuite, Trivy, Checkov, BAS) and prioritizing vulnerabilities: true/false positives and negatives, CVSS 3.1 and 4.0 vectors, EPSS, CISA KEV, SSVC, asset context, mitigation strategies, and remediation validation.
